summary: Running AAP on OpenShift brings operational benefits such as in-place base image upgrades, but deployment settings that depend on the cluster, such as node labels to place workloads on specific nodes, must be supplied by the user because the AAP Operator cannot infer them.
questions: Why deploy Ansible Automation Platform on OpenShift?
Does the AAP Operator set node placement automatically?
What performance settings must I provide for AAP on OpenShift?
